Method of Attack: Intercept and modify sent and received encrypted messages on WhatsApp Web
Change the content of someone else's reply
Change the identity of a sender in a group chat
Send a private message in a chat group disguised as a group message
Attack Vector: Manipulation of the 'quote' feature in group conversations
Custom extension for Burp Suite to decrypt and manipulate messages
Indicators of Compromise: WhatsApp Web key generation phase before QR code is generated
